task: TMDR000002 complementary hotspot and repair audit
restricted_estimand: Matched common-background context-specific Wsp/Aws/Mws mutation supply, competing selected route observations, and independently introduced fixed-route binary recovery controls with justified transport and frozen holdout.

observation_rows.observation_unit: One selected first visible motile population per sampled plate, followed by one sequenced colony; ntrB-only Sanger sequence.
observation_rows.context_and_common_ancestor: SBW25 AR2-derived immotile backgrounds with 10 synonymous ntrB motif variants. Most ntrBC constructs moved to mini-Tn7; one native-locus allelic-exchange exception. Shared strain family, distinct motif/genomic backgrounds, motility selection, not matched WS conditions.

context_matched_independent_WAM_mutation.available: Experimental selected hotspot/Other proportions and Fisher odds ratios support context-dependent hotspot comparisons; no independent unselected μ per division for each W/A/M route.

selected_competing_route_outcomes.available: Selected hotspot versus Other and ntrB mutation outcomes in motility restoration; not competing Wsp/Aws/Mws WS outcomes. Other molecular genes not authenticated by ntrB-only sequencing.

independent_cultures_or_populations.status: described as independently evolved populations; row-level lineage not checked
independent_cultures_or_populations.limitation: Three variants seeded four colonies per plate; use first-zone-per-plate unit, not four winners. Founding-colony/batch mapping unavailable.
